title: City Finance: Business Taxes
issuer: City of Seattle, Office of City Finance

passages.question: Is the Seattle return part of the state excise return?
passages.excerpt: The Seattle business license tax is not the same as the Washington State B&O tax. You must file your Seattle taxes separately from your state taxes.

passages.question: When was the Q3 2026 return due, and what does filing it late cost?
passages.excerpt: 3rd quarter ends Sept. 30 Oct. 31 ... 1st month after the due date 9% of tax owed 2nd month after the due date 19% of tax owed 3rd month after the due date or anytime after 29% of tax owed
